newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices follow futures lower.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices follow futures lower.

text.p: Arabica coffee prices in the Bremen physical market fell $9-12 per 50 kg fob on the week in line with futures reductions, traders said on Friday.
Trading remained thin as consumers expected Colombian and Centralamerican new crops to reach the market soon.
Brazilian sellers discounted offers for October-November.
Kenyans and Tanzanians remained relatively expensive although new crop Kenya cost $144 versus fly crop offers at $153 last week.
Robustas markets were awaiting the Vietnamese new crop and Indonesian EK-1 grade were down $3 at $68 cif Oct shipment.
